title: Does Cracking Your Knuckles Cause Arthritis? #shorts
description:
True or false? Comment before the end. Do you crack yours?
One doctor cracked the knuckles of only one hand for over 60 years to find out.

Sources: Improbable Research (Ig Nobel 2009), Live Science, The Conversation, deWeber et al. 2011 (J Am Board Fam Med), University of Alberta via ScienceDaily (2015 MRI study)

Not medical advice: if a joint hurts or swells, see a doctor.

#shorts #mythbusting #science #funfacts
